sentences.text: The genus Maresaurus and its type species Maresaurus coccai were named by Gasparini in 1997.
Recent phylogenetic analysis classifies Maresaurus as a rhomaleosaurid within the family Rhomaleosauridae.
This animal lived between 170.9 and 168.6 million years ago during the Middle Jurassic (Bajocian) in the Los Molles Formation of Argentina.
